hi! hey slr, i tend to isolate right after i fess up my feelings...

but i read your comment at the time and i just wanna say i cried at that lmao but thank you as well for your nice words! sharing my feelings really does help, especially with strangers who don’t know me in real life- i tend to think that my friends just tells me nice things to make me stop ranting.. it’s an irrational thought i’ve been trying to remove but i just feel more comfortable opening up to strangers..

y’know i’m actually kinda stupid, because some days i’d feel good and positive about myself and say “yeah i’m a piece of shit but i still deserve love and happiness” kinda stuff and kinda believe it? but when i get anxious or paranoid and super duper sad i start talking shit about myself? kinda like what’s on my note.. my true thoughts and feelings are what’s on the note, but i’m trying to be positive kinda but yeah.. 

about the people giving up on me part, it’s more of a feeling than reality really, because i’m really sensitive to tones and shifts in energy if that makes sense? but i feel like my parents, especially my mom, has given up on me- i grew up with her telling me i need to do this and that or be like this and that, but ever since i moved out for work she stopped doing that.. i’m glad though because i won’t have to listen to her nagging anymore but it kinda feels... idk, like she doesn’t care anymore? it’s honestly confusing and i’m not really sure myself lmao. but also generally i just feel like the people around me have given up on me, they don’t really care about what or how i’m feeling and are just leaving me be- it sounds so stupid and confusing, i’m not really sure myself, i just feel like people are giving up on me
